title: Malicious code in @i18n.site/cli-win32-x64 (npm)
description: The npm package @i18n.site/cli-win32-x64 version 0.1.10 contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. This compromise potentially grants full control to an outside entity, risking exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a separate, uncompromised device is strongly advised.
